discussion_statement: The processed reference provides strong within-reference discrimination but not deployment validity.
interpretation_limit: Processed stratified reference only; no temporal, transfer, prevalence, or deployment inference

discussion_statement: The reference condition did not resolve a universal learner or calibration advantage.
interpretation_limit: Non-resolution is not equivalence; calibration was not assessed under deployment prior shift

discussion_statement: Chronological development produced higher forward ranking than random development across five registered seed linkages.
interpretation_limit: Chronology and family composition remain entangled; 5/5 is descriptive; target was historically opened

discussion_statement: Ranking transfer and frozen operating-point transfer diverged.
interpretation_limit: No post-holdout adaptation or prospective deployment recalibration

discussion_statement: Shortcut-subset effects were split- and learner-dependent and did not identify one causal mechanism.
interpretation_limit: Sensitivity is not leakage or causal proof; controls are conditional

discussion_statement: TreeSHAP agreement and LIME local-fidelity failure are distinct explanation properties.
interpretation_limit: Study-specific samples and criteria; no common architecture explanation

discussion_statement: Cross-dataset transfer was directional under the evaluated bridge62 contracts.
interpretation_limit: Directions, populations, preprocessing, and prevalence differ; no symmetric portability claim

discussion_statement: Bridge70 serialization correction changed metrics in different directions, while GROUNDED_S4 cells remained cancelled.
interpretation_limit: Metric-specific sensitivity; cancelled cells have no measurements

discussion_statement: High projected PPV can coexist with high workload, while low workload can reflect negligible detection yield.
interpretation_limit: Fixed-rate prior-shift, traffic, service-time, capacity, and cost assumptions; not SOC observation

discussion_statement: Stage26 establishes feasibility only for measured compatible component paths on recorded hardware and software.
interpretation_limit: No end-to-end latency, portable timing, energy, or unsupported-backend inference

discussion_statement: Historical FT-Transformer, graph, MTemporal, CNN, ViT, and explanation branches remain separate and descriptive or supplement-only where specified.
interpretation_limit: Separate estimands and environments; no architecture superiority

discussion_statement: LOAO supports selective, family-specific transfer rather than universal zero-day detection.
interpretation_limit: DOS and AUTH_BRUTE_FORCE ineligible; Infiltration has 36 positives and remains descriptive

discussion_statement: Ranking and frozen-threshold detection diverged for some held-out families and learners.
interpretation_limit: Native metrics remain family- and learner-specific; thresholds came from known-family validation

discussion_statement: Five-seed closure strengthens bounded stability claims without establishing significance or causation.
interpretation_limit: Finite frozen seeds; no new blind holdout; seed spread differs from bootstrap uncertainty

discussion_statement: Mixed random-LOAO controls did not isolate a unique temporal or family-composition mechanism.
interpretation_limit: Failure to isolate one mechanism does not exclude all mechanisms

discussion_statement: Reproducibility is structured but heterogeneous: Stage25 scalar calculations are deterministic, Stage26 methodology is archival, and many earlier results remain partial or static.
interpretation_limit: No complete local regeneration claim; external data, closed targets, arrays, models, and environments remain unavailable

discussion_statement: Stage29 added synthesis and traceability but no empirical computation.
interpretation_limit: Registry synthesis is not a new result

discussion_statement: The study supports an evidence-informed evaluation sequence covering population, temporal, shortcut, transfer, operational, computational, LOAO, and stability checks.
interpretation_limit: Recommendations are study-derived and not a universally validated standard
